conceptZh: 手上伸出來的五個部分，可以拿東西或指方向。
object: a bouncy astronaut toy with a fishbowl helmet, a toy glove-hand, and a floating star sticker
morph: the astronaut first builds a silly wrong shape, notices, and fixes it into 指
creativeAngle: 太空人玩偶先拼出歪歪的手，發現後修成「指」；手指指向星星。
promptEn: An 8-second silly animated clip, bright pastel look, soft daylight, no dark grading. In a deep-sky-but-bright cyan toy space station with floating pastel stars, a bouncy astronaut toy in a fishbowl helmet drifts a few inches above the floor, holding pieces of the glyph. 0–1.7s: The first 指 is spoken as he proudly builds a wrong shape, a 手 on the right instead of the left, and floats up beaming. 1.7–3.3s: The second 指 is spoken: he looks, tilts his helmet, and drifts away, sees the mistake, and shrugs. 3.3–4.8s: A quick flip: the pieces swap sides like a coin and 指 appears correct in orange, while the astronaut cartwheels in the air. 4.8–5.7s: As 手指 is spoken, a glove hand pops out of the station wall and a single finger points at a gold star sticker, which twinkles. Final hold (about 5.0–8.0s): the astronaut drifts around the glyph pointing back, the star bobbing; the glyph is rock steady. Voice: a friendly unseen narrator speaks, in Taiwanese Mandarin and at an unhurried pace, precisely these syllables and then falls silent: 指、指、手指（ㄓˇ、ㄓˇ、ㄕㄡˇ ㄓˇ）. The first 指 lands at about 1.0s, the second 指 at about 2.8s, and the word 手指 at about 4.9s, each timed to the picture described above. Keep 指 as the one and only piece of writing on screen, a bold saturated color against a pale bright background, correctly formed with every stroke legible; nothing else is written anywhere. The glyph 指 fills roughly 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped, and stays perfectly still for the final 3 seconds while the lead keeps playing away from the strokes. No real people, no flashing.

conceptZh: 手上伸出來的手指，可以指方向、拿東西。
object: a wobbling tower of orange evidence crates and long orange rulers that a detective pig stacks to reach a fingerprint clue stuck high on the wall
morph: the tower sways, gets one tiny extra piece (the pig's hat) on top, freezes, then topples; the rulers clatter down as the 扌 side and the crates and bent rulers land as 旨 (匕 over a crate-shaped 日), forming 指 center frame
creativeAngle: 改用「疊高再倒塌」的實體笑料：豬探長為了搆到牆上高處的指紋線索，把證物箱和長尺愈疊愈高、踮腳搖晃，最後多放一頂帽子就整座垮下，碎片正好摔成「指」。倒塌後豬探長埋在角落抱枕堆裡，只剩一根手指伸出來指著線索，剛好對上「手指」這個詞。和前一版靜態手偶指星星的做法完全不同，重點是誰想要什麼、怎麼失敗、大崩塌、再收尾。
promptEn:
An 8-second slapstick animated clip, bright pastel look, soft even daylight, no dark grading, no flashing. Setting: a plain pale-cream detective office wall with a mint floor, nothing busy behind. Lead: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat, carrying a round magnifying glass far too big for him; he is eager, clumsy and proud. Only two or three things on screen at any moment.

0–1.3s (want it): A glowing fingerprint card is stuck very high on the wall, top center. The pig skids in from the left, screeches to a stop, raises the giant magnifying glass and his eyes balloon through the lens; he jabs one trotter-finger up at the card and hops in place. At about 1.0s the first 指 is spoken exactly as he slams the first orange evidence crate down under the card and starts the build.

1.3–3.6s (try and wobble): Fast stacking. He heaves up more orange crates and long orange rulers, climbing as he goes, balancing on tiptoe on the top crate, reaching up with the magnifying glass. Each new piece makes the tower lean wider, left, right, wider, his cheeks puffing, the card still just out of reach. Keep the tower centered in frame.

3.6–4.8s (the big topple): He pulls off his deerstalker hat and sets it on the very top as one tiny last piece. Freeze: the tower stops dead, the pig glances sideways at the camera, one eyebrow up. Then the whole stack comes down in a tumbling crash with cartoon squash-and-stretch: the long rulers clatter into the left-hand 扌 (a tall vertical with a hook and two crossbars), a short bent ruler and a curved ruler drop in as 匕 on the upper right, and a crate settles under it as the box-shaped 日 with its middle bar, so the heap lands as the correctly formed glyph 指 in bold saturated orange. At about 4.6s the second 指 is spoken exactly as the last piece clicks into place and the glyph is complete.

4.8–8.0s (payoff and hold): The glyph 指 is centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with clean margins, perfectly still and legible for the whole final 3 seconds, nothing touching or covering the strokes. The pig has been bounced into a small pile of pastel cushions in the lower-left corner, away from the glyph, with only his eyes and hat brim poking out. The fingerprint card flutters down and lands beside the cushions. At about 6.0s the word 手指 is spoken exactly as one pink trotter-finger pops up out of the cushion pile and points proudly at the card, wagging; his eyes crinkle into a dizzy happy grin and a tiny cartoon star circles his hat. He stays in the corner, small and joyful, while the glyph holds.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, Taiwan standard readings, slowly and distinctly with clear tones, reads precisely these syllables and then falls silent: 指、指、手指（ㄓˇ、ㄓˇ、ㄕㄡˇ ㄓˇ）. First 指 at about 1.0s with the first crate, second 指 at about 4.6s as the strokes click into place, 手指 at about 6.0s as the finger pokes up and points. No other speech, no translation, no subtitles; only soft toy-clatter sound effects and quiet background music under the voice.

Text rules: 指 is the one and only piece of writing on screen, correctly formed with every stroke legible, saturated orange on the pale background; the fingerprint card shows only a cartoon swirl, no letters. No real people, no realistic human figures, no watermark, no clutter.

conceptZh: 浣熊花生抱著高高一疊積木助跑，撲倒肚子像保齡球一樣滑過亮晶晶的地板，把一排橘色長條瓶和假扮成球瓶的布忍者全撞飛，散落的瓶子和積木叮叮咚咚落成「指」，花生跳起來豎起手指擺出全倒姿勢。
object: a row of tall orange foam bowling pins plus Peanut's own wobbling stack of orange blocks, with a felt ninja disguised as one of the pins
morph: Peanut's belly slide strikes the pins and his block stack; everything spins up and crashes down into 指: long pins form the left 扌, a bent pin pair forms the upper-right 匕, and his blocks stack into the 日 box below
creativeAngle: 前兩版是太空人慢慢翻轉、豬探長疊塔倒塌，這次改成橫向的肚皮滑行保齡球全倒：動作從左衝到右，一目了然。花生「在錯的時候敬禮」造成第一次失敗，布忍者假扮球瓶、煙霧彈亂放，都是孩子馬上看懂的笑點。最後「手指」配上花生豎起的手指和忍者跟著模仿，聽到的詞和看到的動作同時出現。
promptEn:
An 8-second slapstick animated clip, bright pastel look, soft even daylight, no dark grading, no flashing. Setting: a plain pale-mint wall over a glossy pale-cream floor that shines like a bowling lane; nothing busy behind.

Cast: Peanut, a chubby cartoon raccoon sidekick with a striped tail, hugging a wobbling stack of orange blocks far taller than himself, eager and forever saluting at the wrong moment. Supporting: a tiny felt ninja who believes he is invisible.

0–1.5s (want it): On the right stands a neat row of tall orange foam bowling pins. The felt ninja stands among them holding a pin cap over his head, eyes darting, sure nobody sees him. Peanut peeks out from the left behind his tower, sees the pins and wiggles with excitement.

1.5–3.0s (try and miss): Peanut runs at the pins, then snaps a proud salute mid-run, lets go of his stack, and skids to a stop, windmilling his arms to catch the swaying tower. The ninja's smoke bomb goes off by accident in a soft pastel puff, and he waves the smoke away, still "hiding".

3.0–4.8s (the big crash): Peanut backs way off-screen left, then charges in for a much longer run-up and dives flat on his belly, sliding across the shiny floor like a bowling ball, tower held out in front of him. At about 3.2s, as he dives, the first 指 is spoken. BONK: pins, blocks and ninja fly up spinning with squash-and-stretch and drop into place as the correctly formed glyph 指 in saturated orange. Long pins form the left 扌 (a top horizontal, a tall vertical with a hook and a rising stroke). Two bent pins form the upper-right 匕, and Peanut's blocks stack into the box-shaped 日 with its middle bar below it. At about 4.8s, as the last block clicks in, the second 指 is spoken.

4.8–8.0s (payoff and hold): 指 is centered and uncropped, about 70% of frame height with clean margins, and perfectly still and legible for the final 3+ seconds. Peanut pops up in the lower-right corner, dizzy-grinning, in a strike pose. At about 6.2s, as 手指 is spoken, he thrusts up one paw and wiggles a single finger proudly. In the lower-left corner, the ninja copies him with one felt finger. Neither touches the strokes.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin with Taiwan standard readings speaks slowly and distinctly with clear tones. It reads exactly these syllables, then falls silent: 指、指、手指（ㄓˇ、ㄓˇ、ㄕㄡˇ ㄓˇ）. No other speech, no subtitles, only soft clatter effects and quiet music under the voice.

指 is the only writing on screen. Cartoon characters only, no real people, no watermark, no clutter.
